title: Fix Spurious Git Stashing
summary: Identified GitKraken Desktop auto-start as the source of spurious git stashing. Fixed by: (1) dropped existing stash entry, (2) disabled GitKraken auto-start in devcontainer.json (SEMIO_GITKRAKEN_AUTO_START=false), (3) added stash cleanup guard in post-start.sh that clears any spurious stashes on container start.
